02 / MY STORY

Design is
how I speak.

I'm Prasanna, a poster and graphic designer from Sri Lanka. I enjoy turning ideas into strong visual designs — from cinematic posters and product advertisements to brand graphics and creative campaigns.

I work mainly with Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator, focusing on typography, composition, colour and the small details that bring a design together.

My goal is to keep learning, experiment with new visual styles and create work that communicates clearly and leaves a lasting impression.
